keeps_one_variant: A product keeps at least one variant.
handle_description: The product's address in the storefront: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
list_search_placeholder: Search products by title, handle or SKU
list_empty_description: Products you add show up here, newest first.
list_no_results_description: Search looks at titles, handles and SKUs; vendor, type and tag match whole.
new_description: A product with one variant, saved as a draft. Publish it when it's ready to sell.
error_price_format: Enter the price as a number, like 18 or 18.50.
summary_status_active: Shoppers can buy it in the channels it's published to.
summary_status_draft: Only staff see it. Make it active to sell it.
summary_status_archived: Hidden from shoppers and from the default product list.
delete_description: It's removed with its variants, prices and stock records, and leaves every sales channel. Its media stay in the library and orders keep their lines. Archive it instead to keep it.
details_description_hint: Shown on the product page. Links open in a new tab.
details_handle_live_warning: This product is live: links to its old address will stop working.
publishing_hint_active: The channels that sell this product.
publishing_hint_inactive: The channels that sell this product once it's active: drafts and archived products aren't sold anywhere.
categories_hint: Where shoppers find it when browsing. A category shows its subcategories' products too.
organisation_tags_description: Shoppers can filter by them. Up to 250.
options_hint: What variants differ by, like Size or Color.
options_removes_variants: Saving removes {count, plural, one {a variant} other {# variants}}: {titles}.
options_removes_description: They use values you removed. Their prices in price lists and their stock records stay behind until they're cleaned up.
options_empty: This product is sold one way. Add options if it comes in several sizes, colors or materials: each combination becomes a variant with its own price, SKU and stock.
option_values_hint: Renaming a value keeps its variants. Type several separated by commas, or press Enter after each.
option_value_label: Value {number} of {named, select, yes {{option}} other {this option}}
option_value_blank: Enter a value or remove it.
option_value_repeated: This option already has this value.
option_add_values_label: Add values to {named, select, yes {{option}} other {this option}}
error_variant_price: Enter the price of {named, select, yes {{variant}} other {the variant}} as a number, like 18 or 18.50.
error_variant_compare_at: Enter the compare-at price of {named, select, yes {{variant}} other {the variant}} as a number, or leave it empty.
error_variant_compare_at_low: The compare-at price of {named, select, yes {{variant}} other {the variant}} must be above its price.
error_variant_weight: Enter the weight of {named, select, yes {{variant}} other {the variant}} in whole grams, like 350.
error_variant_duplicate: Two variants are {named, select, yes {{variant}} other {the variant}}. Remove one of them.
error_option_unnamed: Name every option, or remove the ones you don't need.
error_option_blank_value: A value of {name} is blank: enter it or remove it.
error_no_options: Add an option with values first.
error_option_needs_value: Every option needs at least one value.
error_too_many_combinations: Those options make {total, number} combinations; a product has at most {max, number} variants.
error_too_many_variants: That would make more than {max, number} variants.
variants_hint: Base prices in {currency}, before markets and price lists adjust them. A compare-at price shows struck through beside the price, when it's higher.
variants_added: Added {count, plural, one {a variant} other {# variants}} priced like the first: check their prices, then save.
variants_create_missing: Create {count, plural, one {the missing variant} other {# missing variants}}
variants_create_tooltip: A variant for every combination of values that doesn't have one.
variants_bulk_price_label: Price for the selected variants in {currency}
variants_bulk_weight_label: Weight for the selected variants in grams
variant_add_subtitle: It's saved with the rest of your changes.
variant_add_taken: A variant already has these values.
variant_image_none: Add images to the product first, in Media above.
stock_dialog_subtitle: Saved at once, apart from the product's other changes.
stock_error_count: Enter the count at {location} as a whole number.
stock_continue_selling: Keep selling when it's out of stock
stock_no_locations: The store has no locations to keep stock at.
stock_note_description: Why the counts changed, for the stock history.
media_hint: Drag to reorder. The first is the featured image.
media_empty_description: Upload images or videos, or pick them from the library.
media_remove_tooltip: Remove from product (the file stays in the library)
media_upload_placeholder: Drop images or videos here, or choose files
media_picker_no_match_description: Search looks at file names, alt text and titles.
media_picker_empty_description: Upload files on the Media page, or drop them on this product.
prices_hint: What shoppers in each market pay now: the lowest live price among the market's price lists, or the base price where none prices a variant.
prices_unreadable_title: The product's prices couldn't be read
prices_customer_description: Price lists for a group count once its customers sign in.
prices_quantity_description: Of each variant, for quantity breaks.
prices_no_market: No market sells it yet: add it to a market's catalog.
prices_market_facts: {currency} · {tax, select, included {prices include tax} other {prices exclude tax}}
prices_no_lists: The market has no price lists.
